data.name: Ethan
data.gender_notes: Ethan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Eitan, 'firm, strong, enduring'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-y-t-n. Ethan the Ezrahite (Psalm 89). Ethan is a Hebrew name meaning “Firm; strong; enduring”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ethan expresses “Firm; strong; enduring”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Eitan, 'firm, strong, enduring'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ethan total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
